name: ESCO (European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations) v1.2.1
issuer: European Commission, DG Employment, Social Affairs and Inclusion
edition: v1.2.1 classification, English CSV package (files dated 2025-12-16)
statement: The ESCO occupations pillar in its official CSV form: each occupation by concept URI with its preferred and alternative labels, definition and ISCO-08 unit group (iscoGroup), plus the ISCO-08 groups it reproduces (ISCOGroups_en.csv). Includes digital games developer (2513.1), digital games designer (2166.6) and digital games tester (2519). Source of stakeholder roles for the D10 matrix.
